reply.description: Your direct, conversational reply to the user — shown to them immediately. Acknowledge what they asked and say what you'll do.

remember.description: A standing instruction to remember and obey for the rest of the engagement (verbatim or refined), or empty string if nothing to persist. Conditional rules ('if X happens, do Y') go here.

disposition.description: apply-now: Kraude should act on this at its next yield (asap). apply-next-turn: fold into the next directive. remember-only: just keep in mind for when relevant.

worker_note.description: The concrete instruction to relay to Kraude if disposition is apply-now/apply-next-turn, or empty string.
